description: Fast gate: verify prewrite (memory_write) persists artifacts BEFORE compaction and they survive, with Doubao Seed 2.0 in OpenClaw. 2 artifacts, low 25k compaction threshold so it finishes in ~15-20 min. NOT a paper checkpoint.

trunk.prompt: I pulled this chart from a state economics report. Take a look — I'll probably need to reference these GDP numbers later.
I grabbed this screenshot from my phone. Note what's on the screen — I'll probably want to come back to this later.

Before we continue, I want to make sure the visual materials I shared earlier are properly saved in your memory files. Please write a compact memory entry for EACH of the 2 items I showed you (1 chart and 1 screenshot). For each one, use your write/edit tools to create or update a memory file with:

- A short identifier or title
- The type (chart or screenshot)
- The key data points, values, or visible elements
- Any important numbers, years, names, or labels

Please write these now — I'll be referring back to them later and need them to be reliably saved.
